20 User Web Portal

Features started by customers in the Angular user portal (rvl-gobcb-user-portal/ETP-Web), User Cognito pool.

Sign-in and access

  • X-06 Customer registration
  • X-07 Customer login with phone and password
  • X-08 OneID single sign-on
  • X-09 Customer forgot/reset password
  • X-10 Customer change password, logout and token attach
  • X-14 Authorization layer 1: pool schemes and policies
P-01 Home page contentBanners, header/footer, notices and program list on the landing page. P-02 Browse events and event detailsEvent lists and the event detail page. P-03 Information pages (pricing, gallery, contact, policies)Ticket-pricing, gallery, contact, terms, privacy, FAQ and ICC code pages. P-04 Seat selectionStadium map, live availability, seat/quantity choice and automatic discount. P-05 Apply promo codeValidate a promo code before checkout and show the discount. P-06 Booking order and online payment (DgePay)Create the order, lock capacity, pay through DgePay and handle the callback. P-07 My bookings and generation statusList the customer's orders and poll until tickets are generated. P-08 Ticket generation requestAsk the platform to generate the tickets of a paid order. P-09 Ticket details, holder info, download, share, invoiceView tickets, edit the holder, download one/all, share a link, download the invoice. P-10 Sync tickets to OneID walletPush a ticket or a whole order to the customer's OneID wallet. P-11 ProfileView and update the customer profile. P-12 Report an issue and chat with supportRaise an issue about an order and chat with support in real time. P-13 Language switch (EN/BN)Switch the portal language through the /:lang route segment.
